in_sanskrit.name: आग्रानी
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who is at the forefront, the leader
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is at the forefront, the one who leads, the one who is first in line, the pioneer, the front-runner.

in_hindi.name: आग्रानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: पहली सेवादार (Pahli sevadar) - The first servant, the pioneer, the leader.

in_tamil.name: அக்ராணி
in_tamil.long_meaning: மதிப்பெரிகர் (Mathipperikar) - The foremost one, the leader, the pioneer.

in_telugu.name: అగ్రాని
in_telugu.long_meaning: పూర్ణజ్జయోశ్య (Purnajjayosh) - The one who is full of victories, the victorious one, the leader.

in_marathi.name: Agrani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agrani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agrani is a Sanskrit name that means 'mother of the earth'. In Hindu mythology, Agni, the god of fire, is often depicted as the spouse of Agra, the earth goddess. Agrani is the feminine form of this goddess.
